text:
ana-marketing: T-4h until release. Final checklist: changelog published, docs links live, canary schedule confirmed, rollback ready. Holding embargo until final green at full rollout. Ping if anything blocking. @matt-eng @sophia-ops

matt-eng: Changelog pushed to main and tagged v1.2.0. Short snippet:
```
v1.2.0 — 2026-03-23
- improved KV-cache heuristics for long-context (8k+)
- 2x faster batched embeddings for small payloads
- stability fixes for dedicated pools
```
Docs preview URL: https://docs.redwood.inference/release/v1.2/release-notes

jules-marketing: 👍 We're finalizing the launch post. Need confirmed p99 latency for 8k context to include in benchmark blurb. Also going to A/B headline variants — will share copy in a sec.

matt-eng: p99 (8k) on dedicated-80g pool: 120ms. Median ~45ms. Embeddings throughput: 230 req/s (batched). Numbers from last perf-run: https://perf.redwood.internal/runs/8721

sophia-ops: Canary schedule set: 14:00–14:30 PT canary (5%), 14:30–15:30 ramp to 25%, 16:00 full. Alerting -> #release-war-room. Rollback playbook ready; quick revert:
```
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/redwood-inference-api
```

deploy-bot: Canary deploy initiated at 6888885000 — monitoring started.

oliver-sre: Docs redirect live at https://docs.redwood.inference/release/v1.2/ and integrated with CDN. Load tests green (95th percentile under 200ms). I added a note in ops runbook about model-fallback behavior.

jules-marketing: We'll queue the webinar invite (pre-announce) to go out at 17:00 PT. Landing page: https://redwood.ai/webinar/release-1-2 — can we ensure embed tokens for registration are live?

matt-eng: Registration webhook URL confirmed and tested. Commit SHA for release: 9f8b7c6d2a1e4b5f3c2d1e0a. Verify with:
```
git show --name-only 9f8b7c6
```

ana-marketing: Perfect. Marketing will embargo press until 16:15 PT to allow final verification. We'll publish the post at 16:20 PT and open the release notes link then. Everyone please react with :thumbsup: when your part is green.

matt-eng: :thumbsup:
